prompts: What felt heavy today, and what made it lighter?
When did you feel most like yourself this week?
What conversation is still sitting with you?
What are you avoiding, and what would happen if you faced it gently?
Where did you notice beauty you almost walked past?
What did you need today that you didn't ask for?
Which thought kept looping — and is it still true?
Who made you feel seen recently, and how?
What would you tell yesterday-you with more kindness?
What small thing went right that you haven't named yet?
Where did you overgive, and what would enough look like?
What are you proud of that nobody else noticed?
If today had a weather, what would it be and why?
What are you carrying that isn't yours?
When did you last rest without earning it?
What question are you living with right now?
What habit is quietly shaping your days?
What would “good enough” look like this week?
Which fear is louder than the facts?
What did your body try to tell you today?
Who do you miss, and what would you say if they were here?
What are you ready to let end?
Where did you choose comfort over honesty?
What are you curious about that you keep postponing?
How did you take care of someone else — and of yourself?
What memory keeps asking to be written down?
If you could redo one moment from today, which one and why?
What are you becoming, slowly?
What do you wish you had more time for, really?
What are you grateful for that you almost took for granted?
